### To be removed when PR is created
**:memo: IMPORTANT: Please do not create a Pull Request without creating an issue first.**
- _Any changes needs to be discussed before proceeding, failure to do so may result in the rejection of the pull request._
- _Go throw [Pull request guidelines](./../docs/guidelines/pull-request-guidelines.md) if you are not aware of them._

## Bug Description
- Briefly describe the bug and what caused it.

## Fix Summary
- Explain how this PR addresses the issue and any alternative fixes considered.

## Reproduction Steps
1. List the steps to reproduce the bug.
2. Mention any specific environment or setup required.

## Testing Approach
- Describe how you tested that the bug is resolved.
- [Optional] Link to a testing report or video if needed.

## Checklist:
- [ ] Bug is fully resolved, and no related errors are introduced.
- [ ] All relevant documentation has been updated.
- [ ] I have added necessary tests (if applicable).

## Additional Notes
- Add any additional information that could be useful to the reviewer.

## Closing issues
- Link any relevant issues here (e.g., `Fixes #123`).
